concept.title: Emergency Stop System
concept.shortdesc: Learn how the emergency stop system protects operators and equipment.

section.title: System Overview
section.p: The GrainFlow X50 is equipped with a comprehensive emergency stop system that can be activated from multiple locations.

ul.li: Main control panel emergency stop button
Remote emergency stops at conveyor access points

section.title: Standard Model
section.p: The standard model includes one emergency stop button on the control panel.

section.title: Advanced Model
section.p: The advanced model includes three additional remote emergency stops for improved safety coverage across the entire machine footprint.
